title: Procedural Planet Generation - Part 2
author: Obi_745
selftext:
Here is a procedural planet generation I made a while back, the variety you see in the video was achieved with just 5 biome presets. With 20 presets or more the complexity of the planet would grow exponentially. Too bad I don't really have desire to make anything with it. Maybe one day.

P.S. This is an older version of the generator, I kept improving it because the terrain wasn't realistic enough, but I prefer the aesthetic of this one, it created sort of "stepped wall" formations, made it look like some different planet.

comments.author: TheSpriteWizard
comments.body: I fucking love this. Can you share your work flow with me? Every time I try to do something like this in godot i end up with a little marble.

replies.author: Obi_745
replies.body: My advice is to do game development on the slowest PC you have, in my experience, high-end gaming PCs are not suitable for game development, for obvious reasons.

replies.author: TheSpriteWizard
replies.body: What an interesting thing to say. Is that because it forces you to optimize?
